title.en: Chapter 13 — A Wife Who Saw Her Husband

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: سيدة إجت وقالت: زوجي اختفى من تلات أيام.
sentences.en: A lady came and said: my husband disappeared three days ago.

sentences.ar: وأنا شفته من شباك بيت قديم بآخر المدينة.
sentences.en: And I saw him at the window of an old house at the end of the city.

sentences.ar: قالت: صرخت باسمه، وإيد سحبته من ورا.
sentences.en: She said: I called his name, and a hand pulled him back.

sentences.ar: لما فتوا الشرطة، ما لقوا غير شحاد بشفة ملتوية.
sentences.en: When the police went in, they found only a beggar with a twisted lip.

sentences.ar: وكانوا تياب زوجي بالأوضة، ودم عالشباك.
sentences.en: And my husband’s clothes were in the room, and blood on the window.

sentences.ar: هولمز سألها: كان يبعت لك مصاري بانتظام؟
sentences.en: Holmes asked her: did he send you money regularly?

sentences.ar: قالت: كل أسبوع، وما كنا نعرف من وين.
sentences.en: She said: every week, and we never knew from where.
